summary: Zambia's Department of Immigration lists the nationalities that do not require visas — including the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Japan, France and Germany — and says visitors are entitled to a free 90-day visit in any 12 months. It lists other nationalities that can get visas on arrival or from Zambian missions, and others whose visas require advance clearance through the online eServices portal; the KAZA UniVisa lets tourists visit Zambia and Zimbabwe on one visa.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Zambia?
faq.answer: Not if your nationality is on the Department of Immigration's list of nationals who do not require visas, which includes the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Japan, France and Germany. Visitors are entitled to a free 90-day visit in any 12 months. Other nationalities can get visas on arrival or from Zambian missions, or need advance clearance, applied for online through the eServices portal, before travel.

faq.question: What is the KAZA UniVisa?
faq.answer: Zambia's Department of Immigration says the KAZA UniVisa costs USD 50 and lets tourists visit Zambia and Zimbabwe multiple times on one visa, valid up to 30 days in any 12 months while the holder remains within the two countries, and covers day trips into Botswana through Kazungula. It is available at Kenneth Kaunda and Harry Mwaanga Nkumbula international airports and the Victoria Falls and Kazungula borders, or online, in which case holders must arrive at a Zambian port of entry.

faq.answer: Zambia's Department of Immigration says ordinary visitors, business visitors and tourists are entitled to a free 90-day visit in any 12 months from the day of first entry, that the days may not all be given at once, and that the visitor may be required to have them extended at the nearest immigration office, free of charge.

faq.question: How do I get a Zambia eVisa and what does it cost?
faq.answer: The Department of Immigration says you register a user account on the eServices portal, complete the visa application form, upload the required documents and pay by credit or debit card. A single-entry visa costs USD 25. It says to bring your approval letter and receipt when you travel. No official source we could read publishes a processing time.
